title: Moniment
summary: MON'IMENT, noun [Latin monimemtum, from moneo, to admonish.] 1. An inscription; something to preserve memory. 2. A mark; an image; a superscription.

inlines.v: MON'IMENT, noun [Latin monimemtum, from moneo, to admonish.] 1. An inscription; something to preserve memory. 2. A mark; an image; a superscription.
